SELECT
  p.product_name,
  SUM(od.quantity * od.unit_price) AS total_revenue
FROM products AS p
JOIN order_details AS od
  ON p.product_id = od.product_id
GROUP BY
  p.product_name
ORDER BY
  total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT
  c.country,
  COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o
  ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY
  c.country
ORDER BY
  order_count DESC

SELECT
  e.last_name
FROM employees AS e
JOIN orders AS o
  ON e.employee_id = o.employee_id
GROUP BY
  e.employee_id,
  e.last_name
ORDER BY
  COUNT(o.order_id) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  c.category_name,
  SUM(od.quantity * od.unit_price) AS total_revenue
FROM order_details AS od
JOIN products AS p
  ON od.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN categories AS c
  ON p.category_id = c.category_id
GROUP BY
  c.category_name

SELECT
  COUNT(product_id)
FROM products
WHERE
  discontinued = TRUE

SELECT
  c.company_name
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN orders AS o
  ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE
  o.order_id IS NULL
